name: embedding_database_create
description: Create a per-collection datastore: <name>.db (SQLite) + <name>.faiss (FAISS). Embeds documents using the chosen provider (openai/azure/huggingface/local). Vectors are L2-normalized; FAISS index uses IndexFlatIP (cosine).

documents.description: List of document texts to embed and store

metadata.description: Optional metadata for each document (must match length of documents if provided)

provider.description: Embedding backend. Defaults: EMBED_PROVIDER, else by available creds (azure>openai>huggingface>local).

model.description: Embedding model/deployment id. Defaults: EMBED_MODEL, else provider-specific sensible default.

description.description: Optional human-readable description for the collection

HF_TOKEN.purpose: Download Hugging Face models and datasets used by structure/sequence tools.
HF_TOKEN.without: Public models work without it; needed for gated or private repos.

OPENAI_API_KEY.purpose: Generate text embeddings for the semantic tool finder.
OPENAI_API_KEY.without: The tool finder falls back to local embeddings without it.

AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY.purpose: Use Azure-hosted OpenAI models for embeddings (enterprise alternative to OpenAI).
AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY.without: Optional alternative to OpenAI — leave blank if you don't use Azure.

test_examples.description: Find tools for analyzing gene expression data

return_schema.description: What the caller receives. EmbeddingDatabase._create_from_documents returns the whole payload -- there is no `data` envelope -- so this schema is a contract on the entire return.

oneOf.description: The collection was created and every document embedded.

documents_added.description: How many documents were embedded. Equals the length of the `documents` argument.

embedding_model.description: The embedding model actually used, after the provider default was resolved.

dimensions.description: Width of one embedding vector, read from the vectors themselves rather than from the model's declared size.

db_path.description: Filesystem path of the SQLite store, <name>.db.

index_path.description: Filesystem path of the FAISS index, <name>.faiss.

oneOf.description: The request was refused or the step failed. A bare `error` with no `status`, which is what tells this branch apart from the success one.

error.description: Why the request was refused or the step failed.

name: embedding_database_add
description: Append documents to an existing per-collection datastore (<name>.db + <name>.faiss). Uses the same L2-normalized cosine setup. Enforces model/dimension consistency with the collection.

documents.description: List of new document texts to embed and add

metadata.description: Optional metadata per document (must match length of documents if provided)

provider.description: Embedding backend override. If omitted, falls back to collection/env.

model.description: Embedding model/deployment id override. If omitted, uses collection model or env default.

return_schema.description: What the caller receives. EmbeddingDatabase._add_documents returns the whole payload -- there is no `data` envelope.

oneOf.description: The documents were appended to an existing collection.

database_name.description: The collection that was appended to.

documents_added.description: How many documents were newly embedded.

skipped_existing.description: How many of the submitted documents were already in the collection and so were not embedded again. `documents_added + skipped_existing` is the number submitted.

total_vectors.description: Vectors in the collection after the append.

db_path.description: Filesystem path of the SQLite store, <name>.db.

index_path.description: Filesystem path of the FAISS index, <name>.faiss.

oneOf.description: The request was refused or the step failed. A bare `error` with no `status`, which is what tells this branch apart from the success one.

error.description: Why the request was refused or the step failed.

name: embedding_database_search
description: Semantic search over a per-collection datastore using FAISS (cosine via L2-normalized vectors). Supports optional metadata filtering.

query.description: Query text to embed and search with

top_k.description: Number of most similar documents to return

provider.description: Embedding backend for the query vector. Defaults to collection/env.

model.description: Embedding model/deployment id for the query vector. Defaults to collection/env.

return_schema.description: What the caller receives. EmbeddingDatabase._search returns the whole payload -- there is no `data` envelope.

oneOf.description: The search ran. `results` is empty when nothing passed the metadata filters.

query.description: The query as it was received.

results.description: One entry per hit, already cut to `top_k`, in descending similarity.

metadata.description: Whatever metadata was stored with the document; {} when none was.

similarity_score.description: Cosine similarity, from the L2-normalised vectors.

total_found.description: Hits that passed the metadata filters BEFORE `results` was cut to top_k, so it can exceed len(results).

oneOf.description: The request was refused or the step failed. A bare `error` with no `status`, which is what tells this branch apart from the success one.

error.description: Why the request was refused or the step failed.

name: embedding_sync_upload
description: Upload a per-collection datastore to Hugging Face Hub: <name>.db and <name>.faiss, plus metadata files.

database_name.description: Collection/database name to upload (expects <name>.db and <name>.faiss under data_dir)

description.description: Optional dataset description in the HF README

test_examples.description: Find tools for analyzing gene expression data

return_schema.description: What the caller receives. EmbeddingSync returns the whole payload -- there is no `data` envelope.

oneOf.description: Both artefacts reached the Hugging Face dataset repository.

database_name.description: The local collection that was uploaded.

document_count.description: Read back from the local store; null when the store does not record it.

embedding_model.description: Read back from the local store.

embedding_dimensions.description: Read back from the local store.

description.description: The description sent with the upload, or the store's own when none was given.

upload_url.description: Browser URL of the dataset repository.

oneOf.description: The request was refused or the step failed. A bare `error` with no `status`, which is what tells this branch apart from the success one.

error.description: Why the request was refused or the step failed.

name: embedding_sync_download
description: Download a per-collection datastore from Hugging Face Hub into ./data/embeddings as <name>.db and <name>.faiss.

repository.description: HF dataset repo to download from (e.g., 'user/repo')

local_name.description: Local collection name to save as (defaults to repo basename)

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing local files

return_schema.description: What the caller receives. EmbeddingSync returns the whole payload -- there is no `data` envelope.

oneOf.description: Both artefacts were downloaded and found on disk under `local_name`.

local_name.description: The collection name the artefacts were renamed to locally.

db_path.description: Filesystem path of the SQLite store, <name>.db.

index_path.description: Filesystem path of the FAISS index, <name>.faiss.

document_count.description: Read back from the downloaded store.

embedding_model.description: Read back from the downloaded store.

embedding_dimensions.description: Read back from the downloaded store.

oneOf.description: The request was refused, the transfer failed, or it finished without leaving both artefacts on disk -- that last case is the one that carries `missing` and `hint`.

error.description: Why the request was refused or the step failed.

missing.description: Paths that were expected after the download and are not there.

hint.description: What to check in the repository.
